source: Grace, Stewart, Sandkühler, Thomas, Weinstein-Raun, Brauner. Thousands of AI Authors on the Future of AI. arXiv:2401.02843 (PDF read first-hand 2026-10-07; section numbers as in that PDF)

passages.sec6.4_fielding: Out of the 20,066 emails we contacted, 1,607 (8%) bounced or failed, leaving 18,459 functioning email addresses. We received 2,778 responses, for a response rate of 15%.
passages.sec6.3_names: We collected approximately 21,800 names from publications ... We found email addresses for 20,066 (92%) of collected names.
passages.sec5.2.2_participation: The survey was taken by 15% of those we contacted.
passages.sec4.2_headline: Over a third of participants (38%) put at least a 10% chance on extremely bad outcomes (e.g. human extinction).
passages.sec4.3_range: between 41.2% and 51.4% of respondents estimated a greater than 10% chance of human extinction or severe disempowerment
passages.tableD_strata: those who worked in industry were 61% as likely to respond as the base rate ... Women ... 66% ... at least 1,000 citations ... 69% ... people in Asia were 84%

passages.appD_conclusion: We find no evidence suggesting strong participation bias.
